PAO OS / SOLUTIONS

AI solutions for businesses with PAO OS

Connect work. Automate processes. Operate more intelligently with AI.

Every day, businesses handle hundreds of tasks: managing staff, running marketing, serving customers, tracking revenue and compiling reports.

The problem is often not a lack of software, but tools and departments that do not coordinate effectively.

PAO OS is being developed to address that fragmentation.

By combining management tools, workflow automation and specialist AI Agents, PAO aims to provide a shared working environment where businesses can organize, coordinate and control work more easily.

Businesses can start with a specific need, choose a suitable solution and expand gradually when needed.

01 / PAO OS

Business management & operations

Keep track of work, control progress and make informed decisions

As a business grows, managers cannot follow every task through messages, spreadsheets and constant meetings.

Scattered information makes it time-consuming to track progress, assess performance and identify problems.

PAO aims to bring management activities into one system, combining work organization tools with an AI assistant to support operations.

The solution focuses on:

  • Managing plans, tasks and project progress.
  • Tracking responsibilities and task status.
  • Helping consolidate data and prepare management reports.
  • Using AI to analyze information and suggest next steps.
  • Organizing approvals and role-based permissions.

Intended value: Reduce time spent gathering information, improve coordination and help managers focus on important decisions.

02
02 / PAO OS

AI Marketing & Advertising Automation

From an idea to a campaign in an organized process

Modern marketing calls for coordination across research, content, design, advertising and data analysis.

When each task sits on a different platform, teams spend considerable time handing over information, checking progress and bringing results together.

PAO is developing AI Marketing Automation solutions to connect marketing steps and support teams with AI Agents that have different areas of expertise.

Areas of application:

  • Marketing Planning: Helping research markets, develop plans and organize campaigns.
  • Content & Creative: Helping develop ideas, write advertising copy and prepare creative materials.
  • Campaign Management: Working toward integrating advertising activities on Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads.
  • Workflow Automation: Coordinating tasks across production, review and deployment.
  • Marketing Analytics: Consolidating data, supporting performance analysis and preparing reports.

Capabilities involving advertising platforms depend on actual integrations, API scope and the access permissions granted.

Intended value: Help marketing teams reduce repetitive work, organize campaigns consistently and spend more time on strategy, creative work and improving results.

03
03 / PAO OS

CRM, sales & AI-assisted customer care

Connect customer information so every conversation has context

Customers may reach a business through Facebook, its website, telephone or other channels.

When data is scattered, sales teams can overlook requests, lose conversation history or ask customers for information they have already provided.

PAO aims to combine customer management with AI Agents to help receive, handle and follow up on interactions in an organized process.

The solution focuses on:

  • Collecting and managing customer information from connected sources.
  • Categorizing requests and helping identify customer needs.
  • AI Chatbot support for frequently asked questions.
  • Helping prepare advice and customer care content.
  • Organizing the handover of requests to employees.
  • Tracking sales tasks and follow-up work after interactions.

AI uses information according to the data, policies and access permissions configured by the business.

Intended value: Work toward consistent customer care, reduce lost information and help sales teams handle requests more effectively.

04
04 / PAO OS

Business workflow automation

Reduce repetitive tasks so people can focus on important work

Every business has recurring processes: receiving requests, checking data, assigning work, sending notifications and updating reports.

If every step requires manual action, time and resources become spread thin.

With an AI Workflow Automation approach, PAO combines automation tools with AI Agents to organize multi-step processes.

A process could be designed as follows:

  1. 01Receive a request from a connected data source.
  2. 02AI reads, analyzes and categorizes the information.
  3. 03The system determines the next step using configured rules.
  4. 04Assign work to a suitable AI Agent, tool or person.
  5. 05Request approval for important actions.
  6. 06Update the status and record the processing history.

PAO aims to combine AI’s ability to understand information with the consistency of traditional automated workflows.

Intended value: Reduce manual actions, help prevent missed tasks and make processes easier to track and review.

05
05 / PAO OS

Connect ERP, CRM & business systems

Build on existing systems instead of starting again

Many businesses have already invested in accounting software, sales management, ERP, CRM or their own management systems.

Replacing all of these tools is often expensive and disruptive.

PAO is designed as a coordination layer to help connect compatible systems through APIs, webhooks and suitable integration methods.

Depending on the external system, PAO aims to support:

  • Looking up information from several data sources.
  • Combining data for reporting and analysis.
  • Helping synchronize information across processes.
  • Triggering tasks in connected systems.
  • Allowing AI Agents to use tools within their granted permissions.

Integration capabilities are assessed against each business’s APIs, security requirements and technical conditions.

Intended value: Make use of existing technology investments while expanding AI use without replacing the entire operating system.

06
06 / PAO OS

Multi-Agent AI Workforce

Specialist AI Agents working together in one system

One AI Agent can help write content. Another can focus on research, data processing or planning.

In practice, however, a job often requires several areas of expertise and multiple steps.

That is why PAO is being developed around a Multi-Agent architecture, aiming to organize AI Agents into a coordinated workforce that supports work.

Rather than requiring users to work with each AI separately, PAO aims to:

  • Receive requests and analyze tasks.
  • Break work into suitable steps.
  • Select AI Agents and tools according to their roles.
  • Coordinate execution and the exchange of results.
  • Bring outputs together for users to check, approve or continue working on.

This model underpins PAO OS’s AI Chief of Staff direction: an AI coordination assistant that helps organize work around business goals.

Intended value: Help businesses approach AI as an organized work support system, rather than a collection of independent AI tools.

PAO OS / OUR APPROACH

Flexible solutions for your business needs

Start with the process that most needs improvement

Not every business needs to deploy all AI solutions at once.

One company may prioritize marketing automation. Another needs work management, sales support or data connections between systems.

PAO OS aims for flexible, staged deployment:

  1. 01

    Understand the needs

    Identify difficult processes, the tools the business uses and the goals for improvement.

  2. 02

    Choose a solution

    Identify functions, AI Agents and integrations suited to the actual conditions.

  3. 03

    Configure & test

    Set up the operating environment and access permissions, then test workflows before use.

  4. 04

    Evaluate & expand

    Monitor results, adjust operations and extend to other areas of work when appropriate.

Deployment scope depends on the product version, integration readiness and the business’s specific requirements.

Bring AI into your business workflows

Start with a real problem. Build a suitable solution. Expand when it creates value.

PAO OS is being developed to help businesses approach AI in an organized, manageable way that fits their existing resources.

The PAO team can work with businesses to assess needs, identify priority processes and choose a suitable deployment direction.
